concept.subject: Two fern fiddleheads curled into tight spirals on a branch, seen close up against a soft blurred green garden.
concept.composition: The two curls stand side by side below the cannon, the left one centered at a third of the width and three fifths of the height, the right one at two thirds of the width a little higher, each about a quarter of the picture across; their stalks hang down between them to the bottom, the branch runs along the bottom on both sides, and blurred fronds curl at the left edge and across the upper right corner.
concept.layout: 66 round pegs and 73 bricks. Each curl is a traced spiral: its stalk and outer turns are one long brick chain, curved slides that carry balls around and in, with pegs on the inner turn; peg arcs follow the fuzzy halo over each curl, and where the right curl's halo faces the cannon it is a solid rim that sheds balls off the curl. The branch is a brick ledge on both sides and the blurred fronds are brick slides; pegs follow the light band in the upper left, the stems in the background and the branch.

features: Spiral layout (spec 8): two fiddlehead curls traced as spirals

difficulty.note: Harder than the moss: the outer brick turns carry balls around the curls, and the inner pegs stay shielded until the outer bricks are cleared.

background.prompt: A close photo of two fern fiddleheads curled into tight spirals, side by side on a branch against a soft blurred green and brown garden. The left curl is centered at about a third of the width and three fifths of the height, the right one at about 64 percent of the width and 55 percent of the height, each about a quarter of the picture across, light green and cream with a fuzzy brown rim; their uncurling stalks hang down between them to the bottom edge, and the branch they grow from runs along the bottom fifth on both sides. Blurred fronds curl at the left edge and cross the upper right corner.

picture.title: Macro shot of green fern fiddleheads unfurling in natural setting.
picture.author: Tri Warno
